<color=#28a8d7>Profile Analysis</color>
Her Panzer might be thick but when you penetrate it she might just be the Princess you were looking for.

<color=#28a8d7>Archive File</color>
Elsa is always on the lookout for the ultimate vehicle or superior technology that will enable her favorite warriors to change the course of events. Despite constant failures, she is always full of new mischievous ideas.
Contrary to her squadmates we do actually know how Elsa obtained her tank and she is also rather forthcoming about it, Following actions near *redacted* that resulted in her pivoting an almost lost battle into a won one with her recieving the Leopard.
When she appears on the battlefield with her tank it is clear that they are a perfect machine that values precision and control. She acts coldly, deliberately, with absolute composure. For Elsa, every battle is a chess match — and her enemy’s mistake is always their last.

<color=#28a8d7>Profile Analysis</color>
Her Panzer might be thick but when you penetrate it she might just be the Princess you were looking for.
